updated.pageExcerpt: Skip to main content Skip to main content ABOUT AGILENT CONTACT US SELECT COUNTRY ACCOUNT PRODUCTS APPLICATIONS & INDUSTRIES TRAINING & EVENTS SERVICES SUPPORT & RESOURCES ORDER CENTER | 0 Home Products Liquid Chromatography/Mass Spectrometry (LC/MS) LC/MS Ion Sources if(typeof seoImageData != 'undefined'){ seoImageData=seoImageData+"*$*"+'/cs/publishingimages/LC_MS-Ion-Sources-groupBanner.jpg'; } LC/MS Ion Sources LC/MS Ionization Source Technology for Consistent Results The Agilent liquid chromatography/mass spectrometry (LC/MS) ion source portfolio enables analysis of a wide range of samples quickly and accurately. These easily interchangeable ion sources for Agilent LC/MS systems will meet your performance goals and align with your analytical requirements, providing the best flexibility, performance and robustness for your LC/MS analyses. Technologies include the robust electrospray ionization (ESI) source, an atmospheric pressure chemical ionization (APCI) source, as well as a multimode source for added flexibility. For highest-sensitivity applications, the Jet Stream ion source extends the use of electrospray ionization. Agilent ion source technology also includes nanospray ionization for low-flow applications, and a Capillary electrophoresis–mass spectrometry (CE/MS) source for capillary electrophoresis. updated.pageExcerpt: Skip to main content Skip to main content ABOUT AGILENT CONTACT US UNITED STATES ACCOUNT PRODUCTS APPLICATIONS & INDUSTRIES TRAINING & EVENTS SERVICES SUPPORT & RESOURCES ORDER CENTER | 0 Home Products Liquid Chromatography/Mass Spectrometry (LC/MS) LC/MS Supplies & Consumables LC/MS Supplies & Accessories Instrument Supplies for LC/MS Ultivo LC/TQ - compact and powerful triple quadrupole​ Instrument Supplies for LC/MS Agilent manufactures and stocks a range of high-quality supplies for LC/MS to ensure continued high levels of system performance. These supplies include common parts such as ion injectors, capillaries, electron multipliers, and nebulizer needles. LC/MS source supplies ensure the highest levels of source longevity, consistency, and integrity. Agilent also provides gas purifiers including moisture, hydrocarbon, and universal traps and a range of specialist tools suitable for LC/MS calibration, operation, and maintenance. All components and supplies are precision-engineered to Agilent's exacting quality standards. new_press_releases.title: Agilent Reports Third-Quarter Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results
new_press_releases.summary: Agilent reported $1.88 billion of Q3 revenue, 7.3% core growth, broad-based operating-group growth, and higher fiscal 2026 revenue, margin, and non-GAAP EPS guidance.

earningsMetrics.label: Non-GAAP operating margin
earningsMetrics.change: +320 bps year over year; includes ~110 bps tariff-refund benefit

pmInsights: All three operating groups grew on both reported and core bases; Life Sciences and Diagnostics led at 10% core growth.
CrossLab remained Agilent's largest operating group and posted a 34.3% operating margin, reinforcing the strategic importance of service, uptime, compliance, and lifecycle economics.
Agilent raised full-year revenue, operating-margin, and non-GAAP EPS guidance, increasing the financial capacity available for priority workflows and commercial execution.
Tariff refunds contributed about 110 basis points to Q3 non-GAAP operating margin and $0.06 to non-GAAP EPS, so the headline margin expansion is not fully operational.
new_press_releases.watersPmImplication: Pressure-test Waters' instrument, service, informatics, and application proof as one lifecycle proposition. Track whether Agilent converts stronger LDG growth and CrossLab economics into bundled regulated-workflow offers.
new_press_releases.evidenceBoundary: Agilent's filed release does not separately report LC or LC-MS revenue, units, pricing, or market share. Operating-group growth and raised guidance are corporate capacity signals, not direct evidence of LC market-share gain.

pmInsights: All three operating groups grew; Life Sciences and Diagnostics and Applied Markets posted the strongest core growth.

recent_press_releases.title: Agilent Reports Third-Quarter Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results
recent_press_releases.summary: Agilent reported $1.88 billion of Q3 revenue, 7.3% core growth, broad-based operating-group growth, and higher fiscal 2026 revenue, margin, and non-GAAP EPS guidance.

earningsMetrics.label: Non-GAAP operating margin
earningsMetrics.change: +320 bps year over year; includes ~110 bps tariff-refund benefit

pmInsights: All three operating groups grew on both reported and core bases; Life Sciences and Diagnostics led at 10% core growth.
CrossLab remained Agilent's largest operating group and posted a 34.3% operating margin, reinforcing the strategic importance of service, uptime, compliance, and lifecycle economics.
Agilent raised full-year revenue, operating-margin, and non-GAAP EPS guidance, increasing the financial capacity available for priority workflows and commercial execution.
Tariff refunds contributed about 110 basis points to Q3 non-GAAP operating margin and $0.06 to non-GAAP EPS, so the headline margin expansion is not fully operational.
recent_press_releases.watersPmImplication: Pressure-test Waters' instrument, service, informatics, and application proof as one lifecycle proposition. Track whether Agilent converts stronger LDG growth and CrossLab economics into bundled regulated-workflow offers.
recent_press_releases.evidenceBoundary: Agilent's filed release does not separately report LC or LC-MS revenue, units, pricing, or market share. Operating-group growth and raised guidance are corporate capacity signals, not direct evidence of LC market-share gain.
